findings.fact: First save removes embedded Microsoft_Excel_Sheet1.xlsx, chart externalData/package relationship, and original Sheet1 cell-address references. Cached series name/categories/numeric strings and the native one-series bar chart survive. Loss of editable source-data structure is not packaging metadata.
First save materializes explicit chart title RUB; original has no explicit title and autoTitleDeleted=0. RUB already is the series name. No rendering establishes whether appearance changes.

Second save adds a:pPr/a:tabLst/a:tab layout declarations. The previous parser emitted three phantom leading tabs: first slide title, its separate speaker note, and second slide title. The fix ignores only those direct tab-stop declaration children. Literal tabs/spaces, field text, explicit tab tokens and line breaks remain significant.
Category-axis numFmt is absent originally, then [$-409]mm/dd/yyyy with sourceLinked=1, then sourceLinked=0. Saved-pair typed MATCH does not establish visual/style equivalence.
Two slides in order, visibility, ordinary text including literal =SUM(A1:A2), table strings, speaker-note role/status/text and cached chart strings remain preserved.
